RKLB.name: Rocket Lab
RKLB.about: Launch provider (Electron, with the larger Neutron in development) that also builds spacecraft and satellite components.

ASTS.name: AST SpaceMobile
ASTS.about: Building a satellite network designed to provide cellular broadband directly to standard, unmodified mobile phones, in partnership with mobile network operators.

GSAT.name: Globalstar
GSAT.about: Low Earth orbit satellite operator providing voice, data and IoT services, and the satellite partner behind Apple's emergency messaging. Agreed in 2026 to be acquired by Amazon.

VSAT.name: Viasat
VSAT.about: Satellite broadband and communications provider for government, defence, aviation and maritime customers, including the Inmarsat fleet.

PL.name: Planet Labs
PL.about: Operates a large constellation of Earth-imaging satellites and sells imagery and analytics to government and commercial customers.

KRMN.name: Karman Space & Defense
KRMN.about: Designs and manufactures engineered systems and subsystems for space launch, missile and defence programmes.

MDA.name: MDA Space
MDA.about: Canadian space company building satellite systems, space robotics and geointelligence solutions.

FLY.name: Firefly Aerospace
FLY.about: Builds the Alpha launch vehicle, the Blue Ghost lunar lander and spacecraft for government and commercial missions.

LUNR.name: Intuitive Machines
LUNR.about: Lunar exploration company providing Moon landers, lunar data relay and space infrastructure services, largely for NASA.

TSAT.name: Telesat
TSAT.about: Canadian satellite operator with a geostationary fleet, building the Lightspeed low Earth orbit broadband constellation.

RDW.name: Redwire
RDW.about: Space infrastructure company making solar arrays, structures, sensors and in-space manufacturing systems, with a growing defence business.

BKSY.name: BlackSky Technology
BKSY.about: Provides rapid-revisit satellite imagery and geospatial intelligence, mainly to defence and intelligence customers.

SATL.name: Satellogic
SATL.about: Builds and operates high-resolution Earth observation satellites, selling imagery and dedicated satellite capacity.

SPIR.name: Spire Global
SPIR.about: Operates a constellation of small satellites providing space-based data, including weather and radio-frequency data, and space services.

SPCE.name: Virgin Galactic
SPCE.about: Suborbital human spaceflight company developing its next-generation Delta class spaceships for commercial service.

KULR.name: KULR Technology
KULR.about: Thermal management and battery safety technology for space, defence, drones and electric aviation.

MNTS.name: Momentus
MNTS.about: In-space transportation and spacecraft services company offering orbital transfer and hosted payload services.

SPCX.name: SpaceX
SPCX.about: Operates Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy and Dragon, is developing Starship, and runs the Starlink broadband constellation. Listed on Nasdaq in June 2026.

VOYG.name: Voyager Technologies
VOYG.about: Space and defence technology company developing the Starlab commercial space station with partners.

YSS.name: York Space Systems
YSS.about: Manufactures standardised satellite platforms, with a large share of its work for US defence constellations.

HAWK.name: HawkEye 360
HAWK.about: Detects and geolocates radio-frequency signals from satellite clusters, providing signals intelligence to defence and government customers.

SIDU.name: Sidus Space
SIDU.about: Builds the LizzieSat multi-mission satellite platform and provides space hardware manufacturing and data services.

ECHO.name: EchoStar
ECHO.about: Satellite and connectivity company behind DISH satellite TV and Hughes satellite broadband.
